# Freeflow Dynamics

(Also written "Free Flow Dynamics". Freeflow Dynamics is the freediving coaching practice of Natalie Bruce, based in Evergreen, Colorado, USA.)

> Freediving coaching and human-performance programs with professional freediver Natalie Bruce — online worldwide, with in-water sessions by arrangement.

Natalie Bruce is a US professional freediver and human-performance coach. She holds 12 continental and 17 US national AIDA records across depth, static and dynamic disciplines. Freeflow Dynamics is her coaching practice: calm, mindful breath-hold training combined with elite performance methods.

- Location: Evergreen, Colorado, USA. Workshops and clinics across the Colorado Front Range (Denver, Idaho Springs); depth training blocks in Tenerife (Canary Islands) and Dominica. Coaching programs run online worldwide.
- Contact: info@freeflowdynamics.com
- Booking: https://calendly.com/nataliefreediverbruce
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/natalie.freediver

## Coaching programs
- [Pool Training Plan](https://freeflowdynamics.com/programs.html#pool): $175/month, online. 2–3 structured pool sessions per week (static, dynamic & swimming), weekly programming, WhatsApp support. Suits beginners through competitive divers.
- [Full Performance Package](https://freeflowdynamics.com/programs.html#full): $275/month, online. Everything in the Pool Training Plan plus dry & gym programming and a monthly video call. For divers training like an athlete.
- [Private Coaching](https://freeflowdynamics.com/programs.html#private): custom pricing. Fully bespoke 1:1 coaching, online plus an in-water option by arrangement.
